configuration_provenance.owner: AI-assisted initial forecast policy under user authorization; editable estimates, not financial approval
configuration_provenance.operating: FY2026 revenue is reported nine months plus the midpoint of explicit Q4 guidance. FY2026 margin is revenue less the midpoint of full-year expense guidance, including the disclosed litigation charge. Subsequent growth fades to 8%, margin to 35%; both endpoints are analyst policy, not management targets. Operating tax 16% to20% is policy, not the unusually low reported consolidated ETR.
configuration_provenance.investment: Full-year spending-guidance midpoint140bn includes finance principal. Subtract 4/3 of disclosed nine-month principal2.769bn to estimate cash PP&E136.308bn, then add a separately configured3% new financed-assets estimate. Future cash PP&E growth20%,10%,0%,-5% and commissioning10% are modeling assumptions. Cash principal is not deducted a second time. Acquisitions/ventures remain outside this scoped plan.
configuration_provenance.wc: 0.10 of incremental revenue converted to full-revenue cash needs; analyst convention, not calibration from mixed historical CFO. Taxes, capital creditors, acquisitions, financing and collateral excluded.
configuration_provenance.wacc: Shared dated Treasury/ERP observations; company-specific configured beta, spread, target financing weights and tax shield. No observed issuer beta regression or current market weights are claimed.
configuration_provenance.terminal: Independent nominal-USD growth, operating margin, tax, D&A, investment and incremental cash assumptions. No year-five copy or target-EV solving.
configuration_provenance.scenario: Diagnostic offsets only, not researched probabilities, fair-value bounds or guaranteed ordering. Unchanged ratios inherit Base.

diagnostics: FY2026 margin includes the legal charge embedded in management expense guidance; no automatic non-GAAP adjustment or future legal-cash allocation.
Revenue guidance is a range; its midpoint and all subsequent-year fades are estimates, not promises.
Cash PP&E is estimated from inclusive guidance less annualized finance principal; newly financed additions are separately estimated at3% of cash PP&E, not a disclosed split.
Expense D&A starts from 4/3 of reported nine-month cash-flow D&A; commissioning10% is simplified and does not prove expense/vintage completeness.
Terminal D&A14% and investment20% are independent of the annual schedule; asset retirement/transition economics are not reconciled.
Acquisition/venture perimeter, litigation cash timing and equity bridge remain qualified; no current-date valuation, per-share defaults or ten-year extrapolation.
